coastal.title: Kids starting a fire, taking a vehicle set off warning from Mounties in B.C.
coastal.description: Police say a seven-year-old boy found a small blow torch in his home on Sept. 18, managed to connect it to a propane cylinder and started a fire inside his home.

coastal.title: Squamish man uses motion-activated zombie to scare bears away from garbage
coastal.description: More than 33 bears have been killed by conservation officers in B.C. this year, including two that entered stores through automatic sliding doors in Hope and Squamish. It's led to creative solutions to keep the hungry animals away from attractants.

kamloops.title: RCMP remind drivers to stop for school buses after two Kelowna students are struck by a vehicle
kamloops.description: Both students were taken to hospital with what police describe as serious injuries. Arbor View Drive was closed for hours while police investigated.

prince-george.title: 6 decades of Treaty 8 history repatriated to Dane-zaa people in northern B.C.
prince-george.description: Anthropologists from the Ridington family began working alongside Dane-zaa elders in the 1960s to record traditional songs, oral histories, and everyday life spanning six decades.

northwest.title: Break-ins cause up to $60K in damage at Nisga’a cultural site near Terrace
northwest.description: The Gitlaxdax Nisga’a Terrace Society says two break-ins at its Schremp Island property caused an estimated $50,000 to $60,000 in theft and damage. The incidents have forced the society to pause cultural programming while it secures the property and works to restore operations.

all.title: As wildfire season winds down, people in B.C. communities are rebuilding their lives
all.description: As wildfire season winds down, British Columbia communities affected are now shifting to recovery efforts, while those who lost home sift through ashes and attempt to rebuild their lives.
